basic_profile.bio: A 30-year-old guitarist from Melbourne, Australia, deeply passionate about progressive metal and racing video games. By day, I work as a software developer, and by night, I dive into creating intricate guitar solos and exploring fantasy worlds. I'm single, and my typical online hours are during late evenings and weekends. When I'm not coding or jamming, you might find me sketching detailed fantasy maps or tuning my Porsche Boxster.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, which fuels my interest in technology and video games. My love for progressive metal is self-taught; I spent countless hours mastering guitar techniques from my favorite bands. My map-making skills are a hobby developed through online tutorials and community forums.
